articleTitle: Action Recognition with PIR Sensor Array and Bidirectional Long Short-term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The spatio-temporal sequence of human body movements provides important information about daily action patterns. This article presents a pyroelectric infrared (PIR) sensor array for detecting human motion features and develops a bidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network for sequence recognition. A PIR sensor array with five direction-sensitive modules is proposed to detect the changing infrared field induced by the human head, upper limb, and lower limb. The low-dimensional output of the sensor array is directly fed to a multi-layer bidirectional LSTM-based neural network for sequential dependency learning. A PIR data set of seven daily actions is generated by four subjects imitating the predefined movements. Experimental results demonstrate that the presented approach achieves high accuracy in action recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Question Answering for Knowledge graph of Aircraft PHM Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: A question recognition method based on BERT-BiLSTM-ATT-CRF is proposed to solve the problem of entity recognition difficulties faced by Question answering in the field of aircraft PHM. First, the BERT model is used for preprocessing, and then the entity information in the question is further processed by the BiLSTM-ATT-CRF. Then, the Bayesian classifier is used to obtain the question classification. Finally, the Knowledge graph is used to realize intelligent question answering in the field of aircraft PHM. After experimental comparison, the proposed BERT-BiLSTM-ATT-CRF model has better recognition ability in the field of aircraft PHM, with accuracy, recall, and F1 values of 72.236%, 73.563%, and 72.8995% on the aircraft PHM corpus, respectively. The implementation of intelligent Q&A in the field of aircraft PHM is of great significance for the intelligent development of aircraft PHM.

articleTitle: Cloud Instance Resources Prediction Based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Accurate prediction of the type of cloud resource instances is increasingly important for public cloud users and cloud service providers as it relates to reasonable reservation of resources to minimize costs for both parties. However, existing methods cannot predict the instance type of cloud resources based on the workload requested by the user’s application, and rarely consider the characteristics of workload data changes for the real-time prediction. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a cloud resource instance prediction model to predict appropriate cloud instance resource usage in a timely manner. First, we use trend degree (TD) to classify all requested workload into three types of waveform trend patterns. Next, a method based on Hidden Markov model (HMM) is established. Finally, a reasonable cloud instance type can be predicted according to the requested workload. The simulation results show that this method can predict cloud resource instance types, and has higher prediction accuracy than the existing related methods.

articleTitle: Content Richness Evaluation Method For Abstractive Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The abstractive summarization model can generate summaries with factual errors, providing error correction models can solve this general problem. Deleting erroneous facts is the most commonly used important strategy in the error correction process. However, we found through experiments that when using this strategy, the error correction model is more inclined to delete all suspicious content, resulting in a significant reduction in information volume. To ensure both the information richness and factual consistency of summaries, this paper proposes a content richness evaluation method named ASCRE. It evaluates the richness of a summary by measuring the quantity and effectiveness of the information contained within it. This paper demonstrates through experiments that ASCRE can effectively evaluate the quality of abstractive summarization system and error correction models. At the same time, we propose a factual consistency and content richness trade off line as the quality evaluation benchmark.

articleTitle: An enhanced stroke prediction model based on data class balance and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Stroke is an acute cerebrovascular disorder that can be either ischemic or hemorrhagic. Stroke is distinguished by its high rates of morbidity, death, disability, and recurrence. In order to successfully limit the occurrence of stroke, early knowledge of the risk of onset and control of risk variables via science are essential. In this work, we integrate numerous machine learning techniques for prediction with the kmeans smote data oversampling technique. The experimental results demonstrate that the XGBoost model performs rather well, with an accuracy rate of 97%, a recall rate of 92%, and an AUC of 0.955. This model outperforms its contemporaries.

articleTitle: Precision Visual Recognition Application Study for 3C Assembly Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the 3C (Computer, Communications, and Consumer Electronics) smartphone component assembly scenario, building a precise visual recognition system for 3C assembly robots based on small-target detection methods and pixel-level segmentation methods, in conjunction with camera and other hardware designs. Through our precise visual perception system, we achieve accurate identification and positioning of assembly parts, finally controlling the robotic end-effector to perform the assembly operations. Experimental results demonstrate that this system outperforms other algorithms in detection effect and segmentation accuracy. Moreover, this study validates the practical application of the precision visual recognition algorithm by selecting three typical 3C cell phone component assembly scenarios, ultimately ensuring a success rate of 98% for the three assembly processes.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of GRU Interval Prediction of Short-term Electric Load Considering Real-time Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: To improve the precision of short-term load forecasting (STLF) considering the effects of electricity price and to reflect the uncertainty of electrical load better. This research presents a short-term load interval prediction method using real-time electricity price and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU). We make interval predictions for short-term loads using accurate electricity load historical data and real-time electricity price data. The experimental results show that compared with GRU without considering the effect of real-time electricity price, the proposed model has higher coverage probability and narrower interval width, which reduces the interval coverage width criterion (CWC) by at least 30.73%, and it is a methodology with high-quality Pls to solve the short-term load forecasting problem in a better way.

articleTitle: Adversarial Defense based on Image Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Recent research shows that deep neural network is vulnerable to the attack of adversarial samples, which leads to the incorrect output of the model. Therefore, the defense against adversarial attacks on deep learning models has become the hotspot of artificial intelligence security research. This paper proposes an image-processing-based defense method ADIST (Adversarial Defense Based on Image Style Transfer), which removes the adversarial perturbation from the input image by wavelet image restoration, multi-template image style transfer, and feature modulation before the classification by the target classifying model. Specifically, the input image is style-transferred multiple times using different style templates. In each style-transfer branch, the input image is denoised by wavelet decomposed and reconstructed after randomly dropping a certain amount of high-frequency components. Then a feature encoder is applied to the reconstructed image and the style template to extract image features. The image features are further pruned by adaptive truncation to eliminate part of the antagonistic disturbance. Then, the semantic information of the input image is fused with the style-template part to generate a new image by the style-transfer module. Finally, the classification results for these multiple new images are combined to produce the final prediction. We have tested the proposed method using ResNet34 and WideResNet50 as the classification network on the Mini-ImageNet dataset. Under white box attack, the proposed method is 2.2% and 2.7% better than the most advanced RAIN method based on image preprocessing, respectively.

articleTitle: Combining adaptive filtering and motion state for wearable PPG-based heart rate extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) technology is a method to detect the change of blood volume in subcutaneous tissue, which is characterized by simple principle, low cost, non-invasive and sustainable monitoring, and is widely used in heart rate monitoring of wearable devices. However, the original signal obtained by the single-channel PPG sensor contains a lot of noise, especially the motion artifacts generated in the process of motion. In this paper, the acceleration data and synthetic signals in different directions are used for adaptive filtering, and the heart rate data is modified by combining motion state estimation. This method improves the robustness of adaptive filtering. We conducted a test in which ten individuals simultaneously wore watches with three-axis accelerometers and single-channel PPG sensors, Polar heart rate armbands (Verity Sense), and Polar heart rate chestbands (H10) while performing various physical activities such as jogging, running, and jumping for 30 minutes. The three-axis acceleration signal is utilized as the reference signal for adaptive filtering and estimated the user’s motion state, and the heart rate change rate and range are determined according to the motion state, which can correct the heart rate result. Compared with Polar heart rate chestband data, the average absolute error of the entire sample was 7.5 beat per minute(BPM).When the amplitude of motion is not particularly intense, the algorithm proposed in this paper can identify heart rate more precisely.

articleTitle: Generation of Winter Wheat Irrigation Guarantee Capability Index Map Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Irrigation assurance capacity is an important aspect of farmland quality. This study aims to calculate the evaluation indicators of reference crop irrigation assurance capacity by integrating meteorological station data, remote sensing data, and winter wheat spatiotemporal distribution data. The annual effective irrigation volume is calculated using rainfall and actual evapotranspiration from MOD16A2. A regression equation is established to estimate the spatially continuous reference crop water requirement by combining reference crop evapotranspiration from ground meteorological stations and potential evapotranspiration from MOD16A2. The irrigation water requirement for winter wheat is calculated using the crop coefficient method and winter wheat distribution map. The ratio of effective irrigation volume to irrigation water requirement is used as the evaluation indicator for irrigation assurance capacity. This study utilizes deep learning technology to directly generate an irrigation assurance index map for winter wheat cultivation areas in the North China Plain. The results demonstrate that the index map meets the application requirements for visual monitoring of regional farmland quality. By integrating multiple data sources and deep learning technology, this research provides valuable support for agricultural water resource decision-making and serves as a reference for larger-scale indicator mapping studies.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Vehicular GNSS / INS Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Accurate, continuous, and reliable position information is a fundamental requirement for in-vehicle navigation applications. This article focuses on the principles of GNSS/INS positioning and provides a detailed explanation of the loosely coupled model and the Kalman filtering algorithm. A GNSS/INS combined navigation terminal device was developed, capable of providing long-term high-precision, high-timeliness position and attitude data. In this study, a new model for vehicle motion constraints, which enables parameter self-learning in the observation domain, was constructed using multiple regression and deep learning methods. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to traditional methods that rely on variance domain parameter adjustment, the inertial navigation error RMS, when using the multiple regression model, reduced by 71.0%-79.3% in horizontal position, while the utilization of deep learning reduced it by 59.8%-76.0%. The GNSS/INS combined navigation system, designed based on the Tangjun crane LXQY-16, was used as the experimental platform in this article. The navigation performance analysis and comparison of engineering vehicles under static and dynamic conditions were conducted, indicating that the proposed GNSS/INS combined model and its algorithm have a simple mathematical model and are easy to program. The positioning results of the GNSS/INS combined navigation were more accurate and the system was more stable compared to standalone GNSS navigation.

articleTitle: Improving Nighttime Semantic Segmentation with Dual-Domain Mixed Attention and Shallow Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Semantic segmentation in nighttime scenes has garnered considerable attention in the field of computer vision. Recent studies have begun to utilize frequency information to tackle this task. However, existing methods based on frequency solely consider the unidirectional guidance of frequency domain information on spatial features, disregarding the impact of spatial features on the frequency domain information. Moreover, the color and contour information of nighttime images is not prominent, leading to an insufficient contribution of shallow features in nighttime semantic segmentation networks. To address these issues, we propose a dual-domain mixed attention (DDMA) module and a shallow feature enhancement (SFE) module for nighttime semantic segmentation. Specifically, the DDMA module performs a domain transformation on the saliency learned from spatial and frequency domain features, enabling the cross-domain fusion of information in both frequency and spatial domains. The SFE module is employed to enhance the expressive capacity of shallow features within semantic segmentation networks. Extensive experiments on the NightCity, ACDC-Night and BDD100k-Night datasets showed effective improvement in nighttime semantic segmentation performance compared to methods using the same baseline, achieving state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: Research on Genetic Hybrid Algorithm for Rectangle Packing Problem with Multiple Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: A hybrid algorithm based on an improved three-stage nesting algorithm and an improved genetic algorithm is proposed for the optimization problem of two-dimensional rectangular parts nesting. Firstly, an integer programming model with the objective of maximum utilization rate is established, and then the genetic algorithm is used as the nesting algorithm to determine the nesting order of rectangular parts. In order to improve the performance of the genetic algorithm, the improved SFM chaotic mapping method is used to initialize the population, and the triple tournament selection operation and Gaussian disturbance strategy are introduced to improve the convergence speed and global search ability of the algorithm. For the positioning of rectangular parts on the blank, a three-stage cutting and nesting algorithm is proposed, which introduces the concept of "layer" and restricts the length of the blank to meet the requirements of guillotine-cut and rotation of rectangular parts. Finally, the proposed algorithm is compared with other advanced algorithms, and the results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dictionary learning algorithm with nonconvex regularizations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Nonlinear dictionary learning can process and model nonlinear signals more accurately than mainstream dictionary learning methods. However, existing nonlinear dictionary learning is based on convex sparse regularization, which is difficult to achieve the desired results. In this paper, we propose a nonlinear dictionary learning algorithm based on DCA direct optimization using the minimax-concave penalty (MCP) and the generalized mini- max-concave (GMC) sparse regularization, which is nonconvex, to enforce the strong sparsity of the model and to obtain the exact solution. We compare the proposed algorithms with the corresponding linear dictionary learning algorithms in numerical simulations and real image denoising experiments. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of integrated intelligent information system for manned spacecraft based on cloud platform and smart home technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: For manned spacecrafts, astronauts have become an important part of the whole system, and the human-machine interaction ability of spacecraft information system will directly affect the astronauts’ work efficiency, even the success of the mission. In addition, with the improvement of spacecraft payload support capability, spacecraft information system needs to forward, calculate and store lots of experimental data when processing its own control instructions and state information. And how to make full use of system capability to process data in real time is also the key part of information system design. Combined with the mission requirements of future manned spacecraft, an integrated intelligent information system design method based on cloud platform and smart home technology is proposed, which comprehensively uses system resources to meet the requirements of spacecraft control and state monitoring, long-term astronaut residence, and experimental data processing. The effectiveness of the method is proved by software simulation and spacecraft on-orbit test.

articleTitle: CTW-Net: A Deeper Multiscale Feature Fusion W-Shaped Network for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Nowadays, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely adopted in medical image analysis. Nevertheless, the inherent local nature of the convolution operator leads to limitations in capturing long remote dependencies. Fortunately, the self-attentive mechanism in Transformers can effectively model long remote dependencies. Therefore, we construct a hybrid network (CTW-Net) for medical image segmentation that combines the benefits of CNN and Transformer more effectively. We first construct a pure convolutional multiscale transformer (PCM Transformer) to multiscale the features obtained from the hierarchical encoder and decoder. It utilizes Hadamard product for second-order spatial interactions to fuse features at multiple scales, enabling the network to concentrate on more significant regions of lesion characteristics. Besides, we developed an efficient maximum pooling residual block (EMPR) based on convolution and maximum pooling. The EMPR block enables the complementation of locally important features in the downsampling process, which raises the performance of lesion segmentation. Experimental outcomes reveal that our network has achieved excellent segmentation performance in breast ultrasound and colon polyp lesion segmentation.

articleTitle: Impact Factors Analysis on Path Selection of Passengers in Urban Rail Transit Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: As the development of urban rail transit moves towards the stage of networked operation, the factors which affect path selection of passengers in emergency situations are becoming an important focus of research. For revealing the laws of passengers path selection under urban rail transit emergencies, a semi-compensated multinominal logit (MNL) model is proposed to analyze the impact factors of path selection of passengers. The main factors affecting passengers’ path selection are confirmed depending on three aspects including individual attributes of passengers, travel characteristics, and rail transit service level, and sensitivity analysis is conducted to explore passengers path selection behavior. The experimental results show that the individual attributes, travel characteristics, and rail transit service level of passengers have a significant impact on their path selection. Commuters are more willing to choose a travel plan with more transfer times but shorter travel time. For leisure travelers, they are more willing to choose a travel plan with fewer transfers but relatively longer travel time. The research results can provide theoretically and practically scientific basis for predicting passenger flow under emergencies.

articleTitle: Multi-task Tomato Fruit and Bunch Maturity Detection Approach Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Cherry tomatoes are well loved by people all over the world as a fruit that can be eaten fresh. The detection and ripeness grading of both individual tomato fruits and fruit clusters are necessary conditions for inspection robots to perform inspections. To achieve a three-task detection of tomato fruit and bunch detection, fruit ripeness and bunch maturity grading, a multi-task detection network based on YOLOv7 was proposed in this paper. We first constructed a dataset of cherry tomatoes satisfying the multitasking requirements. Next, the YOLOv7 backbone network was selected and two additional decoders were added to the Head section to simultaneously implement tomato bunch identification, fruit ripeness and bunch ripeness detection. Finally, the multi-task loss function was designed and SIoU was substituted for CIoU to improve the accuracy of model recognition. The experimental results showed that the proposed model had good detection performance and maturity grading without significant increase in memory overhead and network depth. With an IoU threshold of 0.5, the average detection accuracy of cherry tomato bunches and fruit ripeness reached 86.9%, and average inference time was 4.9ms. In the future, it is expected to play an important role in the field of automated inspection.

articleTitle: Quality prediction of continuous annealing process based on HDFI-SVR Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: During the continuous annealing generation process, predicting and monitoring product quality to improve product quality and reduce waste is of great significance. With the improvement of automation, the soft sensor model based on historical process data is also gradually applied to the continuous annealing process. However, the continuous annealing data have the characteristics of high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and strong coupling, which will be a great test for the model establishment. In order to fully consider the impact of data characteristics on modeling, we combine the Isometric Feature Mapping (Isomap) algorithm with the characteristics of integrated learning to further consider the impact of sample differences. At the same time, Support Vactor Regression (SVR) was selected as the sub-learning machine, and then the High-dimensional data features integrated- SVR (HDFI-SVR) model was proposed. Compared with the Adaboost-SVR and SVR models, the model has better convergence speed, generalization speed, and modeling accuracy in different benchmark data sets. After that, the method was applied to build a continuous annealing product quality prediction model, and the experimental results verified the effectiveness of the method. The proposed HDFI-SVR modeling method is more suitable for strip hardness prediction than other test methods.

articleTitle: An efficient container bin-packing method for large scale cloud-native clusters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Scheduling tens of thousands of containers in large scale cloud-native clusters faces great challenges. Imbalanced resource utilization and fragmentation is a key challenge. To address this, we propose an efficient resource scheduling optimization method for large-scale data center. By exploiting the similarities in resource usage among instances within each cloud-native application, our approach aims to find a set of optimal application colocation hints for each application under different types of physical machines. The optimized colocation hints can be used in bin packing algorithms, allowing for efficient and effective resource management in data centers. Experiment results show that our proposed solution outperforms the classic FFD and DP algorithms in ter ms of the number of saved physical machines and the resource usage standard deviations of cluster nodes.

articleTitle: EKIGCN: External Knowledge Injected Graph Convolutional Networks for Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) is a challenging subtask in the natural language processing community, which aims to determine the sentiment polarity about the corresponding specific aspect terms. In existing works, external knowledge has been proven effective to improve the ABSA tasks’ performance. However, it is still essential to study further to find a universal method for ABSA tasks. Therefore, we propose an external knowledge-injected graph convolutional network (EKIGCN) to enhance the sentiment representation with commonsense. Specifically, Sentic Net is leveraged to provide external knowledge to construct an affective dependency graph. In order to fully exploit the effectiveness of affective knowledge, a shallow mutual interaction is utilized to fuse the learned contextual representation and the graph. Besides, to make EKIGCN sensitive to aspect terms, an aspect-aware multi-head attention module is also employed to enhance the corresponding relations between aspect and contextual words. Extensive experiments are conducted on three popular datasets to validate the effectiveness of our proposed model, and the results outperform the mentioned state-of-the-art methods in ABSA tasks.

articleTitle: Fine-grained Classification of YOLOv5 Remote Sensing Aircraft Targets Incorporating Broad Learning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In the paper, a method of fusing broad learning image classification network and YOLOv5 classification algorithm to improve the fine-grained classification ability of the model was proposed. Firstly, a broad learning hybrid stack model was constructed using the broad learning system and its variants as well as the stack structure. Then, the aircraft model features extracted from the YOLOv5 classification algorithm network were used for training, and the precision of fine-grained classification was improved by enhancing the ability of feature extraction and nonlinear expression of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of YOLOv5 algorithm’s aircraft type classification by 0.8%. Compared with other algorithms, the proposed algorithm is more suitable for deployment on the mobile devices.

articleTitle: Adaptive reppoint: an efficient approach for orientated object detection in remote sensing imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: With the improvement of the remote sensing technology, more and more remote sensing imagery data can be obtained easily. Therefore, the object detection in remote sensing imagery becomes an important task in computer vision area. However, the object of remote sensing imagery are presented with multi-scales, arbitrary orientation and complex background, which make the task becomes challenging. Currently, the mainstream object detection methods of multi-scales and oriented objects, such as RepPoint, which focus on learning a set of adaptive points and generating the point set to the bounding box (with angle information) of the objects. However, the diversity of categories and complex background always make the learned points (in adaptive points set) deviating outside the ground-truth bounding box, which will yield inaccurate location of the objects and decrees the detection result. To deal with this problem, this paper proposes a spatial constraint method that can enforce penalties on outlier points within the point set. Firstly, a reasonable evaluation metric is proposed for quantifying the distance between the outlier points and the ground-truth; Secondly, an spatial constraint parameter is defined for the objects in different scales. Extensive testing was performed on the challenging DOTA and HRSC 2016 datasets. According to the results, the proposed method demonstrated a performance improvement of 1.84% and 0.4% for the respective datasets.

Author Keywords: Object detection in remote sensing imagery

articleTitle: Sentiment Classification Based on RoBERTa and Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is one of the hot research topics in natural language processing, aiming to analyze the subjective sentiment expressed in text through inductive reasoning. Common deep learning-based sentiment classification models often require the integration of word embedding techniques. However, conventional approaches to generating word embeddings struggle to effectively capture the bidirectional semantic features of text. RoBERTa, with its unique attention mechanism and masked technique, enables the capture of more comprehensive features in the text. In this paper, we introduce the RoBERTa model to the task of Chinese comments sentiment classification and address the limited data issue by employing data augmentation methods to expand the dataset. Through a series of experiments conducted on three different datasets, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the sentiment classification model that combines RoBERTa with data augmentation methods.

articleTitle: Research on calibration method of fisheye cameras based on VTD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In the autonomous driving domain, the fisheye camera is often used as an important sensor of environment perception. In order to realize the simulation and verification of advanced intelligent driving assistance system (ADAS), the simulation of fisheye camera is becoming more and more important. The traditional camera calibration has many problems, such as long process, poor accuracy and complex process. The checkerboard was used as the external parameters calibrating board, which was imported into VTD scene simulation software, and the external parameter calibration of the fisheye camera was realized through the coordinate system transformation. The tool LensDistortion is used to generate intrinsic parameter distortion. The results show that the fisheye camera calibration method can be well applied to validate the function of ADAS domain controller.

Author Keywords: Intrinsic parameter and external parameter calibration

articleTitle: A Deep Unsupervised Representation Learning Architecture using Coefficient of Variation in Hidden Layers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present a novel cov-RBM model on the basis of Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) and the coefficient of variation (CoV), where the learning process is instructed by the CoV eigenvalues with respect to the hidden layer. Further, a deep unsupervised representation learning architecture (DURLA) is proposed to explore the capacity for representation learning with continuous excitation of CoV eigenvalues. We subject the proposed DURLA to extensive experimentation on nine real-valued datasets. The final experimental results show that our methods have a better effect than traditional and state-of-the-art ways.

articleTitle: A Pythagorean fuzzy information acquisition method based on BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper presents a method to obtain Pythagorean fuzzy information (PFI) based on a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) neural network. The method first uses the Word2Vec word embedding model for vectorized text pre-processing. Then, to solve the problems of one-way propagation and gradient explosion in traditional recurrent neural networks, BiLSTM is used to extract the global features of the comment information. Finally, the PFI is constructed based on the Softmax classifier and Pythagorean fuzzy set definition. Experimental results show that the proposed method can accurately capture online reviews’ satisfaction, dissatisfaction, and hesitation sentiment tendencies. Compared with other methods, such as RNN, CNN, LSTM, and GRU, the proposed method has higher accuracy, precision, and F1 values.

articleTitle: LineMod-2D Rigid Body Localization based on the Voting Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Occlusion effects have been a serious issue in industrial grasping for poorly textured workpiece bit position estimation. In this paper, we present an improved LineMod-2D algorithm called I-Line2D, which combines the matching mechanism of the voting statistics of the Generalized Hough Transform to achieve the bit-pose estimation of partially occluded objects. The method first calculates the similarity score of each feature point by LineMod-2D’s unique fast similarity calculation system, then indexes the high scoring feature points using their gradient directions, votes on the center position by finding the reference table established in advance, and gives different weights to the votes according to the different scores, and gives higher voting weight to the high scoring points. The experimental results show that among the data collected by ourselves, the method proposed in this paper can achieve 88%, 87% and 86.3% matching results in the actual occlusion data under the blurring of nonlinear illumination, noise ratio of 0.1, and filter kernel of 5, and also achieves a better matching result in the simulated occlusion data with rotation and scale change. And it outperforms the traditional LineMod-2D method in tests with different occlusion degrees.

articleTitle: Shuffled Frog-leaping Algorithm Based on Heap and Fractional Order
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The traditional shuffled frog-leaping algorithm uses sorting algorithm and exhaustion method during population partitioning and local evolution, respectively, which leads to inefficient operation of the algorithm. In addition, it does not make full use of the useful information contained in the updated individuals during the subpopulation update process. Therefore, a new shuffled leapfrog algorithm based on heap and fractional order is proposed. Firstly, a heap storage structure is used to maintain the population of frogs to optimize the efficiency of the algorithm. At the same time, makes the population in a chaotic state at initialization increasing the global disturbance to improve the overall optimization performance. Secondly, the fractional order operator is introduced in the local update strategy of the algorithm, and the Euclidean distance method is used to select the most recently updated individuals containing useful information to construct a new fractional order local update strategy, which makes the algorithm increase the local disturbance and memory in the subpopulation loop iteration, so as to improve the population diversity. Finally, the algorithm is verified to have stronger merit-seeking ability through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: URF4CCT: A Text Understanding Framework for Chinese Telecom Fraud Cases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of telecom fraud cases in recent years, there is a growing need for efficient and accurate text understanding techniques to aid police officers in investigating and combating these criminal activities. However, the the complexity of Chinese case texts, the absence of a unified framework for the domain, and the reliance on specialized data annotations pose significant challenges in extracting and representing key information from such texts. In this interdisciplinary study, we propose a unified representation framework for Chinese telecom fraud case texts named URF4CCT using pretrained language models. By employing prompt technology with prior vocabulary enhancement module, URF4CCT improves the model’s ability to capture the unique characteristics of telecom fraud case texts. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed method in low-resource and few-shot scenarios. This research contributes to the development of effective text understanding techniques for telecom fraud cases and facilitates police officers’ investigation efforts in online criminal activities.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Simulation Teaching Platform for Campus Robot Based on ROS-Gazebo
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper aims to address the limitations of current virtual simulation teaching platforms for robots, such as lack of versatility and timely instructional feedback. To achieve this, we have designed a campus robot virtual simulation teaching platform based on ROS-Gazebo. Firstly, the platform consists of a versatile human-computer interactive interface designed with QT, integrated with an algorithm library containing various classic algorithms required for experiments. Secondly, we have established a campus environment and a simulation robot using the Gazebo platform, while optimizing the kinematic model and other parameters of the robot. Finally, the feasibility of the platform is validated through hierarchical experimental teaching. Experimental results demonstrate the high fidelity of the platform in reproducing offline course experimental scenes, the flexibility in designing experimental content, and its ability to meet the needs of students with different abilities. Importantly, the designed environment exhibits practical equivalence to real experimental scenes and offers good portability, thereby laying a foundation for implementing robot experiments in real scenarios.

articleTitle: KALNS for a Multi-depot Split Delivery VRP with Customers’ Multi-Requirement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) is a well-known NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem, which has wide spread applications in real world. This paper investigates a novel VPR, called multi-depot split delivery vehicle routing problem with customers’ multi-requirement (MSDVRP-CMR) according to an actual process of logistics distribution. It owns multiple depots, customers, and vehicles, and customers’ multiple goods requirements can be split delivered by vehicles. A mixed-integer linear programming formulation is presented. Then, an enhanced K-means and Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (KALNS) algorithm is proposed for addressing this problem. First, K-means, C-W, and Greedy operations are designed for better initial solutions. Furthermore, ALNS global search with various destroy and repair operators are developed, and 3-OPT local search are proposed to further enhance its search ability. Extensive simulation is conducted and its results show that the augmented KALNS is effective and well outperforms ACO, ALNS and Gourbi.

articleTitle: Multi-Detail Significant Target Attention Generation Adversarial Network for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Visible images and infrared images are complementary, and their fusion can effectively improve image contrast and texture details. This paper proposes a multi-detail object saliency attention generative adversarial network for infrared and visible light image fusion to preserve more detailed textures and salient objects. We enhance the texture and contrast of the source image through guided filtering and linear normalization. Dense modules and SENet attention mechanism modules are used to improve the network’s ability to obtain effective information, and skip connections are added after each layer to retain more information. In addition, two sets of discriminators are used to discriminate between visible and infrared images to effectively limit the generator to produce high-quality fused images. Experiment results show that the proposed method has achieved better performance in multiple evaluation indicators and has better visual effects, with clear and rich textures and prominent targets.

articleTitle: Survey of Multimodal Sentiment Analysis Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive review of deep learning applied to multimodal sentiment analysis. Firstly, it briefly outlines the concept, background, and significance of multimodal sentiment analysis. Subsequently, it delves into the application of deep learning techniques in the domain of multimodal sentiment analysis. Furthermore, the paper summarizes advancements in multimodal fusion and interaction technologies. It concludes by discussing future trends and prospects of multimodal sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Diagnosis from X-Ray Images Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Efficient screening of COVID-19 patients is very critical to the allocation and management of hospital resources. This paper presents a model Covid-DenseNet that can rapidly diagnose COVID-19 from chest X-ray (CXR) images. By combining transfer learning and the addition of attention mechanism, we extracted the feature information from CXR images and carried out internal weight allocation of the feature information. We also design a multiscale fusion architecture to fuse multiple scale features after weight allocation to obtain more feature information, so as to improve the model’s ability to correctly identify chest radiographs. Experiments were conducted on the COVID-QU-Ex dataset, and the accuracy of Covid-DenseNet was as high as 96.89%.

articleTitle: 3M: Multi-Task Multi-Prompt Learning Model for Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) is an NLP task that classify fine-grained sentiment towards one specific aspect from the same text. While Pretrained language models (PLMs) like BERT have been widely researched in ABSA, attaching aspects to corresponding sentiment remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Multi-task Multi-prompt learning Model (3M) to introduce more proper semantic information for different task aims. In 3M, the ABSA task is divided into two subtasks, a classification task for aspect categorization and a generation task for sentiment analysis. For specific task, we design respective prompt learning approach to help model understand ABSA more accurately. Note that the overfitting using BERT on ABSA, we utilize the method of float loss to restrict the training not too small. The experiment result shows that 3M achieves results comparable to SOTA.

articleTitle: Image Aesthetics Assessment for Virtual Cinematography of Cloud-based Performing Arts Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Cloud-based performing arts is an innovative form of traditional performing arts that embraces new artistic expression. Lens language is widely used in the production of performing arts programs, which helps to enhance the artistic expression of performance content. One of the cores of its aesthetics expression is image composition. However, great majority current intelligent cinematography methods tend to overlook the learning of lens language attributes, resulting in the inability to obtain camera images that effectively reflect the composition and cinematographic intention. Therefore, in the cloud-based performing arts scenes, we propose an aesthetics assessment framework for virtual cinematography, which is designed to select the optimal camera position and angle to make its view image composition closer to the designed composition patterns until aesthetics assessment results meet expectations.

articleTitle: Multimodal RU-Net: A Segmentation Network Based on Multimodal Cardiac CMR Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) is crucial for the pathological segmentation of the central muscle in the diagnosis of myocardial infarction (MI) patients. The automatic segmentation technology of medical images has achieved significant success with the development of deep learning technology. However, due to the low contrast of the target area edges, irregular lesion areas, and insufficient medical image data, automatic segmentation of myocardial pathology still has great challenges. In this article, we propose an improved RU-Net model called a Multimodal RU- -Net. Used to segment edema and scar areas in multimodal cardiac CMR data. In this network, we use RU-Net as the basic model, embed our proposed multimodal image feature extraction module (MFF) in the encoding path to enhance the extraction of complementary information between different modal images, and add attention modules in the skip connection and encoding path to enhance attention to the regions of interest in the image. The experiment shows that both modules mentioned above effectively improve segmentation accuracy. In addition, we have adopted methods such as data augmentation, deep supervision, and combination loss to further improve segmentation accuracy. We evaluated multimodal RU-Net on the MyoPS2020 challenge dataset and achieved a Dice score of 64.4% in scar segmentation and 70.7% in edema and scar segmentation. We achieved almost equivalent performance to the most advanced single stage segmentation methods on the MyoPS 2020 ranking, and our proposed method outperformed it in the standard deviation of dice scores, The test results are more stable. This indicates that our proposed method is meaningful for automatic segmentation of myocardial pathology.

articleTitle: Application research of smart-home system for manned spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: At present, the human-computer interaction system of manned spacecraft is oriented to meet the mission function, and has the characteristics of relatively single and independent function, poor compatibility & expansibility and long development cycle. It is difficult to meet the needs of long-term astronaut in-orbit in terms of user experience. For the future manned spacecraft, this article proposes application research of smart-home system for manned spacecraft which is featured as intelligence, network and commercialization. The application research studies the overall design and its protocol architecture, and also plans the functions of space smart-home system in details. This application research shows that this scheme can comprehensively improve the efficiency, convenience, comfort and intelligence for manned spacecraft.

articleTitle: CMCLNet Cross-Modality Attention Fusion and Cross-Level Feature Interaction for RGBD salient object detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: So as to address the issue of edge defects in RGB-D based salient object detection, we propose a novel structure called Cross Modality Attention Fusion and Cross-Level Feature Interaction (CMCL), with the aim of improving edge quality and effectively extracting salient object from complex backgrounds. Our network is an encoder-decoder structure, specifically, (1) a cross-modality attention fusion (CMAF) module is proposed, which enhance and fuse relevant information of RGB images and depth map, then output enhanced features; (2) the cross-level feature interaction (CLFI) module is proposed to improve edge quality in the encoder stage, combining low-level edge features with high-level semantic information; (3) In the decoder stage, we put forward a gate fusion unit (GU) to reduce background noise, enhancing the significant features of the images. We carry on experiments quantitatively and qualitatively on six publicly available RGB-D datasets and compared them using four evaluation indicators. The results show that our network outperforms mainstream salient detection methods to a certain extent, which is of great significance for solving the key problem of salient object detection in computer vision.

articleTitle: A rapid method for removing complex backgrounds for potato early blight monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Image detection technology is an important method for large-scale potato early blight monitoring. Due to the interference of complex background, the epidemic disease images detection methods often have a high misjudgment rate, which leads to the instability of disease detection results. This paper proposes an improved algorithm based on ExG (Super green feature algorithm). Firstly, this method realizes three-channel separation of RGB image pixels in epidemic disease image data set, and calculates the corresponding weights of each channel. Then, according to the characteristics of the RGB image color, the single-channel data is processed and merged to achieve the purpose of removing a large number of irrelevant color backgrounds. Impurities similar in brightness and contrast to diseased leaves still exist in the processed image background. This method uses the triangle algorithm to achieve threshold segmentation, find the maximum connected domain to remove impurities, and improve detection accuracy. The images of common potato early blight spots were selected to study. Experimental results show that the rapid detection method proposed in this paper is efficient and stable.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement with Lip Perceptual Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The speech enhancement task aims to improve the perceptual quality of speech signals. Most of the existing models cannot guarantee the perceptual quality of the enhanced speech due to the use of Ll or L2 loss. In this paper, we designed a new perceptual loss based on lip movement for the speech enhancement model. There are two motivations for using lip-based perceptual loss: one is that the content of spoken language has a strong correlation with lip movements; the other is that studies have shown that multimodal speech enhancement models based on audio-clip information perform better than audio-only models by using lip information as auxiliary information for speech enhancement task. In addition, to obtain perceptual features and calculate the perceptual loss on the audio-only dataset, we designed a network that generates lip movements from speech signals guided by the Wav2Lip model for this task. Experiment results show that using lip movement-based perceptual loss can effectively improve speech enhancement performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to MRI Reconstruction: Complex Neural Networks with Hierarchical Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper introduces LCPNN, a novel complex neural network that leverages Laplacian pyramid methodologies to effectively reconstruct magnetic resonance images of superior quality from sparsely sampled k-space data. The study elucidates three pivotal contributions: 1) The implementation of a novel framework that adeptly exploits the advantageous multi-scale attributes of Laplacian pyramid decomposition, 2) the formulation of a sequential multi-scale network structure that integrates intricate convolutions within the aforementioned framework, and 3) the verification of the method's auspicious potential in conserving image edges and intricate textures via experiments conducted on the publicly accessible MICCAI dataset.

articleTitle: Surgical Instrument Segmentation Based on Geometric-aware Semi-supervised Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Medical image segmentation often requires a large number of annotated images, which can be difficult to obtain. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semi-supervised learning framework with two branches, each consisting of an encoder and two decoders for geometry-aware constraints and pixel-level contrastive learning, respectively. Compared to existing techniques, our framework introduces a signed distance map (SDM) method for geometric constraints, which leverages distance information from pixels to the nearest boundaries to infer the shape and edges of objects and enforces geometric constraints during training. Additionally, to better utilize unlabeled data, we design a projector that elevates feature maps after the segmentation decoder, allowing for pixel-level contrastive learning through the construction of positive and negative feature pairs. This enables us to learn different feature representations and improve segmentation performance. Our proposed method is evaluated on three publicly available datasets, and experimental results demonstrate its superior performance compared to several state-of-the-art semi-supervised segmentation methods, emphasizing the effectiveness of our proposed framework.

articleTitle: Detection of Microcrack in Eggs Based on Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The automatic identification of egg cracks is crucial in egg defect detection and quality grading. To improve the accuracy and precision microcrack detection of egg, this paper proposes an improved U-Net based egg microcrack segmentation method: using the lightweight network MobileNet-V2 as a backbone to achieve real-time egg crack detection and improve the detection speed while embedding the CBAM attention mechanism in the cross-layer fusion stage of features to enhance the feature extraction of egg microcracks. In this paper, more than 3400 egg crack Patch grading datasets are created for network training using a single point backlight light source structure. For egg microcracks with a Crack width of less than $20 \mu \mathrm{m}$, the improved network achieves pixel accuracy, crack-IoU, and Mean Intersection Over Union (MIoU) of 77.04%, 65.01%, and 82.24%, respectively, under the inference speed of 80 ms for a single image (1 million pixels). For egg microcracks with a width of less than $5 \mu \mathrm{m}$, the Crack-IoU and MIoU of this method were 59.24% and 79.46%, severally. Compared with the traditional U-Net and classical semantic segmentation models, this method can detect microcracks more quickly and accurately. The recognition accuracy in the cracked egg classification test is 99.26%, which satisfies the actual online egg crack detection demand.

articleTitle: Option pricing using deep convolutional neural networks enhanced by technical indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Artificial Neural networks are increasingly employed for option pricing in recent years. However, the pricing ability and effectiveness of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have not been investigated adequately in the field of financial options. Hence, it is interesting to investigate whether convolutional neural networks are effective in pricing Chinese options. In this paper, an innovative idea of combining 2D-CNN with market technical indicators (TIs) has been implemented. The research is conducted based on the 50ETF options which are obtained from Shanghai Stock Exchange covering a time span from January 2018 to December 2022. Having compared the pricing accuracies between the CNNs (with and without TIs) and the Black-Scholes model, we show that the method of combining CNNs with technical indicators (TIs) are effective in pricing Chinese options. This research is useful for practitioners and researchers in the field of option trading.

articleTitle: Hybrid algorithm of invasive weeds and particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of low optimization accuracy and easy to fall into local optimum of particle swarm optimization algorithm, a hybrid algorithm combining the invasive weed algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. The main structure of the hybrid algorithm is PSO, and IWO makes the algorithm avoid falling into local optimum. The simulation test is carried out with 11 benchmark test functions, and through comparison with the other two improved PSO algorithms, it is concluded that the hybrid algorithm in this paper is not easy to fall into local optimization and has high optimization accuracy.

articleTitle: SpriteHyper2vec: A SCSPRITE Data Completion Method Based on Hypergraph Random Walk
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: scSPRITE is an emerging method to capture multi-way chromatin interaction and generate high-resolution, genome-wide three dimensional (3D) genome organization in single cells. However, the data obtained from scSPRITE often contain missing values and exhibit sparsity, making it difficult to directly observe local structures of the 3D genome at the level of single cells or even small cell populations. Additionally, comprehending the chromatin conformation composition entails a large number of cell populations by scSPRITE with huge cost. Therefore, it is valuable to impute these missing values and extract higher-order structures using computational methods. Here, we propose SpriteHyper2vec, a single-cell imputation algorithm based on hypergraph, specifically designed for scSPRITE datasets, which effectively capture local and global topological structures by generalizing Node2vec method. When compared with original method, SpriteHyper2vec significantly improves the similarity between small cell populations and the benchmark data. Furthermore, the completion capability of SpriteHyper2vec enables the identification of A/B compartment-like structures even in small cell populations. In summary, SpriteHyper2vec effectively enhances the visualization and comparison of 3D organization in small cell populations based on scSPRITE data.

articleTitle: Study on Informational and Intelligent of Vehicle Security Check and Audit Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: At present our country road traffic accident rate high all year round, motor vehicle safety detection becomes more and more important. Due to the limitation of manpower and material resources, the traditional vehicle detection technology can not meet the current requirements. Based on the above deficiencies, this paper designed and implemented an artificial intelligence vehicle safety detection platform, self-built vehicle detection image data set, and used a series of methods, such as YOLOv4, SAR, multidimensional convolution, attention mechanism, to automatically complete the detection of external hardware and internal information of motor vehicles. The experimental results show that our method has high speed and high precision, which can not only be used for motor vehicle detection, but also can be extended to real-time road safety detection in the future. It has high innovation, advanced nature and broad engineering application prospect.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Spatio-Temporal GCN for Human Pose Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Human pose forecasting predicts future human postures based on a given sequence of human postures. The fusion of spatio-temporal joint dependencies has a significant impact on model output, but research in this area is relatively scarce. This paper introduces a spatiotemporal graph convolutional neural network that effectively fuses multi-channel information with learnable multi-channel topology. We have designed a multi-branch module to capture temporal features from diverse spatial domains. Moreover, we initiatively adopted DST to optimize long-term forecasting. Our network has been evaluated on 3DPW and AMASS datasets commonly used in motion prediction. The results of the experiments showed that our methods were up to the current state of the art.

articleTitle: Control and Design of Pole-changing Motor Driver
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Many scholars at home and abroad have conducted a lot of research on pole-changing induction motor, but in conclusion, when switching motors with different pole pairs, which makes it impossible to obtain stepless speed regulation like ordinary three-phase motors. This paper analyzes the literature and develops a control system suitable for two-speed pole-changing motor drive, using a single MCU with dual cores to obtain a continuous speed during the pole-changing process, which can truly widen the speed range for intelligent electronic control system of automobile. This paper verifies the feasibility from theoretical design of the drive circuit to experiments, and brings a new prospect for the development of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: A Swarm Intelligence Algorithm for Global Optimization Based on Neural Network Control System Swarm and Game Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper uses a new optimization algorithm employing a neural network control system that swarms with game decision-making (NNPS-C) to solve global optimization problems. The transfer function is added to the original feedback loop, it is combined with the PID controller to form a single-neuron controller, and multiple single neurons are connected to form a neural network controller. Concurrently, the fill function allows the control system to jump out of the local optimum. The grouping method is similar to the company’s organizational structure; it divides neural network subsystems into several groups with a pyramidal structure. In the meantime, the subsystems of each layer are connected with other subsystems via game decision-making, including the connection with the farthest layer. Finally, five test functions are used to prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Chinese named entity recognition based on MacBERT and Joint Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Extracting medical entities from Chinese medical texts is of great significance to the establishment and application of medical information systems. Chinese text lacks spacers to segment words, which makes it difficult to recognize entities. Therefore, this paper proposes a named entity recognition method combining MacBERT and Joint Learning. The MLM as correction BERT (Mac-BERT) pretrained language model, which alleviates the differences between pre-training and fine-tuning stages, obtains dynamic word vector feature expression, and then enters into a framework that integrates the named entity recognition task and the word segmentation task for joint learning, so as to improve the feature capture ability of the model. Experiments show that the model can effectively obtain the important entities in the instruction of traditional Chinese medicine. On the Chinese medicine instruction dataset, fusing MacBERT with Joint Learning model achieved the best result with 68.43% F1, which increased by 1.6% compared with the two-layer BiLSTM non-joint model, and increased by 1.07% compared with the combined BERT with Joint Learning model. Experimental results show that the recognition performance is better than that of the non-joint model and other pretrained models.

articleTitle: A Data Importance-Aware Migrations Strategy Design in Hybrid Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The premise of data migration is to have a more accurate set to be migrated. However, in the traditional single storage system, due to the different data access characteristics of all the storage devices, the high complexity of the devices, and the high computational cost, which lead to the poor reading and writing performance of the system devices, the large error rate of identifying data, and further reduce the utilization rate of resources. Therefore, this paper is committed to proposing a data migration evaluation model based on data importance. Through literature method and experiment, it analyzes the significance of data and the impact of various data characteristics and indicators of potential value on the importance of data, establishes a scientific and reasonable evaluation method, and judges the cold and hot degree of data according to the degree of data importance. Simulation experimental results show that compared with only considering access frequency and access time, the hit rate of data migration under the proposed evaluation model is improved.

articleTitle: A deep learning-based model for forecasting rice leaf folder Cnaphalocrocis medinalis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The rice leaf folder (Cnaphalocrocis medinalis) is one of the worldwide pests that pose a significant threat to rice crops. Severe infestations can lead to substantial yield reductions in rice production. Effective and timely prediction of this pest at a regional scale is essential for controlling and preventing its damage. Based on the daily field observations of moth population data from 2010 to 2022 at the Hunan Plant Protection and Quarantine Station in China, a composite model combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) called LSTM-GRU was proposed to predict the occurrence of the rice leaf folder. To validate the advantages of this model, the predictive results of LSTMGRU were compared with those of single models and other hybrid models. The results indicated that the LSTM-GRU composite model demonstrated greater stability and accuracy compared to the single models and other hybrid models. This provides a more precise method for predicting the occurrence of the rice leaf folder.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction for IGBT based on SO-Bi- ALSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Aiming at the fatigue failure problem caused by the cycling influence of electrical stress and thermal stress of IGBT during working state, this paper presents a remaining useful life (RUL) prediction method based on Snake Optimizer (SO) to optimize the stacked bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) neural network model. Firstly, the peak voltage of collector-emitter in the IGBT aging data provided by NASA data center is selected as the characteristic parameter, and the wavelet transformation is used to preprocess the data. Secondly, the Bi-LSTM neural network model is constructed and the attention mechanism is introduced to calculate the allocation weight of the time series, which enhances the expression ability of the nonlinear features of the hidden layer, and adopts SO to optimize the BiALSTM neural network training hyperparameters and construct the SO-Bi-ALSTM neural network prediction model. Finally, the mean absolute error (MAE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) are selected as the evaluation criteria, and the prediction accuracy of extreme learning machine (ELM), Transformer, LSTM and SO-Bi-ALSTM models is compared and analyzed. The results show that the MAE predicted by the SO-Bi-ALSTM model is 0.0173, the MAPE is 0.0921%, and the RMSE is 0.0160, which indicates the prediction performance of SO-Bi-ALSTM is better than the other methods.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Code Similarity Detection Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: To enhance code security and stability, code similarity detection techniques are crucial for identifying known software code vulnerabilities, particularly in open-source code. Traditional code clone detection methods based on Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) have shown limitations in achieving satisfactory results. To address this, researchers have turned to deep neural network models for extracting latent semantic features from code. This paper presents a novel methodology that leverages an enhanced AST to extract semantic information from the source code. A Tree-Long Short-Term Memory (Tree-LSTM) neural network is then utilized to encode the AST into function feature vectors. The similarity between code snippets is determined through cosine similarity calculations on these feature vectors. The experimental results demonstrate the significant advantages of this approach in code similarity detection, enabling effective identification and prevention of known code vulnerabilities. Thus, ensuring software security and stability.

articleTitle: Importance Guided Query Focused Long-Input Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Query focused long-document summarization aims to generate a summary depending on both the given query and the given long text. Previous end-to-end method inputs the query and long text into a single model, and generates the summary. However, it’s a difficult task for the end-to-end model to recognize which parts of the long text are more important for answering the query. Besides, the length of the query is too small, so the information of the query is diluted after concatenating with the long text. As a result, many summarized sentences are irrelevant to the query. In this paper, we propose IGQFS (Importance Guided Query Focused long-input Summarization), which predicts an importance score for each sentence as an auxiliary task, and simultaneously generates the summary. To this end, we design an improved cross-attention module for the decoder according to the predicted utterance importance scores. Experimental results on QMSum dataset show that the auxiliary task and improved cross attention module generate summaries more related to the queries, and our method performs better than the end-to-end baseline model.

Author Keywords: Utterance importance scores guided cross attention

articleTitle: Research on load prediction model considering migration scale index based on CNN-BiLSTM-Attention algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper established a new load prediction model according to the data of regional population migration scale index, and further introduced temperature for correction. Then solved the load prediction model by CNN-BiLSTM-Attention algorithm. Finally, through the analysis of cases compared with the traditional prediction models, the accuracy and validity of this model were verified. And the accuracy of load prediction could be effectively improved by taking into account the migration scale index and temperature through the ablation test. The model provided a more accurate method for load prediction in regions of mass movement of population during special holidays.

articleTitle: LPT-One and BFD-One Search Algorithms for Load Balance and Bin-Packing of Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Cloud computing contains large-scale tasks and resources. Currently, the local search is a considerable choice in ensuring both computational complexity and optimization. Based on our previous research on multi-route search algorithm to reduce makespan, we apply BFDO and LPTO algorithms to address load balancing and bin-packing problems. Through abundant experiments, we validate the superiority of our proposed BFDO and LPTO.

articleTitle: Game confrontation model of USV based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Based on the excellent performance of deep reinforcement learning in solving multi-agent game problems, this paper proposes a multi-unmanned surface vehicle (multi-USV) confrontation game model. The model aims to solve the game problem among multi-USV, learn the strategies and behaviors of USV through deep reinforcement learning, and complete the confrontation game. We carry out experiments in the simulation environment, and apply the model to the cooperative game confrontation task of multiple USV. The results show that the model can learn the strategy of joint attack on enemy vehicles, which has a good practical function great and research value.

articleTitle: A Trusted Access Scheme for Power Distribution Intelligent Sensing Equipment IoT based on Dynamic Token
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: With the development and application of the Internet of Things, introducing a variety of power distribution intelligent sensing devices into the traditional power network to collect real-time information has become the mainstream in the industry. Such network is called the power distribution intelligent sensing Internet of Things. Due to the narrow bandwidth of most low-power wireless gateways, narrow bandwidth IoT communication protocol is often used. At the same time, the access environment of the IoT presents the characteristics of open network and weak computing ability of the devices. Therefore, we design a special trusted access scheme based on dynamic token for the communication protocol adapted to the IoT of power distribution intelligent sensing equipment. The trusted access scheme we proposed includes the network framework, access flow, protocol parameter exchange flow, data message format and error handling scheme. Then, we analyzed the scheme and compared it with other access schemes in the simulation environment. The results show that the scheme has good performance and can adapt to the terminal access scenario of power distribution equipment.

articleTitle: Predictability of Cellular Network Traffic Based on Conditional Entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The prediction of cellular services can help operators adjust the network status in advance to meet the QoS requirements of users. Evaluating the upper boundary of prediction is the key to designing prediction algorithms. The traffic of cells in cellular networks has strong temporal periodicity and is related to the traffic features of adjacent cells. Therefore, three types of entropy are proposed to measure its predictability: (1) Temporal entropy, (2) Spatial entropy, and (3) Spatiotemporal entropy. The Fano equation is used to calculate the predictability boundary, which provides a prediction boundary for the base station traffic prediction of cells in cellular networks, and the effectiveness of the proposed entropy has been verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Knowledge-enhanced Pre-training large language model for depression diagnosis and treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 9th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligent Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Depression, a pervasive psychiatric disorder characterized by concealment, dependence on expert judgment, and a notable rate of misdiagnosis, poses a substantial burden on society.
